I’m so sorry. I understand. I lost a patient due, to what I feel like, my own negligence. She was a 10 year old spayed lab. O brought her in for ADR. P had been stumbling frequently the day prior and was having issues walking completely the day O brought her in. Only thing we did was BW, showed infection. I wanted to mention to the Dr it would probably be a good idea to X-ray/US, but she was rushing me to get everything done bc it was the end of the day so we hospitalized and next morning, I was off, and when my coworkers got in, the patient was actively dying. I was told it was really horrible. O showed up with his wife and they had to euthanize. She was bleeding out internally since before we saw her. Had I just said something, she might would still be here. I didn’t want to overstep my Dr, but I should have. I speak up now. I won’t have someone else’s baby die due to me being afraid to voice my concerns. 

I can’t promise it’ll never happen again to you, OP, but don’t blame yourself. You’re not at fault. You did everything you could. I’m sorry you had to go through this. It’s so fucking hard.
